svg.title: Forester — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as forester, wearing a work jacket and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A stepped conifer silhouette stands beside a clearly graduated tree-measuring staff. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
